items.headline: 国内汽柴油每吨上调260元和250元
items.headline_en: China raises petrol and diesel prices by 260 and 250 yuan per tonne
items.summary: 国家发改委9月11日公布临时调控：汽、柴油每吨实际上调260元、250元，低于按现行机制计算的435元、420元。
items.summary_en: The NDRC announced temporary controls: petrol and diesel rise by 260 and 250 yuan per tonne, below the formula-based increases of 435 and 420 yuan.

items.headline: 世界气象组织：全球经历最热8月
items.headline_en: WMO reports the hottest August on record
items.summary: 世界气象组织汇总多机构报告：2026年8月为有记录以来最热8月，北半球6至8月也创夏季高温纪录。
items.summary_en: WMO reports that August 2026 was the hottest August on record, while June–August was the Northern Hemisphere's warmest summer.

items.headline: 世卫预认证多剂量包装RSV孕妇疫苗
items.headline_en: WHO prequalifies a multi-dose maternal RSV vaccine
items.summary: 世卫组织宣布，孕妇用RSV疫苗的多剂量包装通过预认证；该疫苗借助母体传递的抗体保护出生后前六个月的婴儿。
items.summary_en: WHO prequalified a multi-dose maternal RSV vaccine. Antibodies transferred before birth protect infants during their first six months.

items.headline: 欧洲央行宣布三项关键利率上调0.25个百分点
items.headline_en: ECB raises its three key interest rates by 0.25 percentage points
items.summary: 欧洲央行9月10日宣布加息；其工作人员预测2026年通胀率为3.0%、经济增长率为0.9%，并强调前景高度不确定。
items.summary_en: The ECB raised rates on 10 September. Staff project 3.0% inflation and 0.9% growth in 2026; the bank stresses that the outlook remains highly uncertain.

items.headline: 教科文组织公布非洲历史展览安排
items.headline_en: UNESCO announces an exhibition on African history
items.summary: 教科文组织宣布9月17至22日在巴黎总部展出非洲对人类进步的贡献，展览以《非洲通史》为基础，使用档案、地图等材料。
items.summary_en: UNESCO announced a 17–22 September exhibition in Paris on Africa's contributions to humanity, drawing on its General History of Africa and archival materials.

source.name: 联合国教科文组织 / UNESCO

items.headline: NASA公布空间站乘组返航前记者会安排
items.headline_en: NASA announces a pre-return briefing for its station crew
items.summary: NASA宣布Crew-12乘组将于9月16日在空间站举行记者会；乘组须待Crew-13抵达并完成短期交接后才离站。
items.summary_en: NASA announced a 16 September briefing from the station by Crew-12. The crew will leave after Crew-13 arrives and a short handover is completed.

source.name: 美国国家航空航天局 / NASA

previous_answers.headline:
从8×8棋盘上删去
两个相对的角格。
证明：剩下的62格不能用
1×2骨牌完全覆盖。
previous_answers.headline_en: Two opposite corner squares are removed from an 8 by 8 chessboard. Prove that the remaining 62 squares cannot be tiled by 1 by 2 dominoes.
previous_answers.explanation: 把棋盘按相邻格异色染成黑白两色，原来各32格。相对的两个角格同色，删去后两色分别剩30格、32格。每块1×2骨牌必覆盖一黑一白；31块骨牌必覆盖31黑、31白，与剩余格数矛盾。因此不能完全覆盖。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Colour adjacent squares black and white. Initially there are 32 of each colour. Opposite corners have the same colour, so removing them leaves 30 of one colour and 32 of the other. Every domino covers one square of each colour. Thus 31 dominoes would require 31 black and 31 white squares, a contradiction.
previous_answers.subject: 上周证明题

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上周思考题 · 参考解答 / LAST WEEK · ANSWER
previous_answers.headline:
30名申请者随机到场，
实力各不相同。
面试后须立即录用或淘汰，
且只能录用一人。
怎样做最可能录用最强者？
估计成功概率。
previous_answers.headline_en: Thirty applicants of different ability arrive randomly. Accept or reject each immediately, and hire only once. What strategy is most likely to choose the best, and what is its success rate?
previous_answers.result_en: Reject the first 11; success is about 37.9%
previous_answers.explanation: 假设只知道已面试者的相对排名。非当前最强者不可能胜出。令V_k为淘汰前k人后继续的最优成功率，V_30=0。第k人以1/k概率为当前最强，录用其获胜概率为k/30，故V_{k-1}=V_k+max(0,k/30−V_k)/k。倒推得先淘汰11人，再录用首位刷新纪录者；若无则录用最后一人。成功率=(11/30)×(1/11+…+1/29)≈37.9%。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Assume only relative ranks are observed. Non-records cannot win. Let V_k be the optimal success chance after rejecting k applicants; V_30=0. Backwards, V_{k-1}=V_k+max(0,k/30-V_k)/k: applicant k is a record with probability 1/k; accepting it wins with probability k/30. This gives 11 initial rejections, then acceptance of the next record (or the last applicant). Success is (11/30)sum_{j=11}^{29}1/j, about 37.9%.
previous_answers.subject: 上周建模题

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上周思考题 · 示例估算 / LAST WEEK · SAMPLE ESTIMATE
previous_answers.headline:
中国高铁列车一天合计
大约行驶多少万公里？
给出一个数值或数量级，
并说明主要假设。
previous_answers.headline_en: Roughly how many tens of thousands of kilometres do China's high-speed trains travel in total each day? Give a number or order of magnitude and state your main assumptions.
previous_answers.result_en: Sample estimate: about 8 million km per day
previous_answers.explanation: 示例估算：只计中国高铁载客列车的运行距离，不计乘客人数，也不计空车调动。假设每天开行1万趟单程列车，每趟平均800公里，则1万×800=800万公里/日，量级为每日千万公里。两项输入均为估算假设，不是核实后的运营统计；改变假设会改变结果，并无唯一答案。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Sample estimate: count train-kilometres for passenger services on China's high-speed railways, excluding empty movements. Assume 10,000 one-way services per day, averaging 800 km each. Then 10,000 × 800 = 8 million km per day, of order 10 million. Both inputs are assumptions, not verified operating statistics. Different assumptions give different answers.

editorial_notes: 本批次按定时模式生成2026-09-14周一待审稿。六条主候选覆盖能源、气候、卫生、货币政策、文化和航天；三条备选仅供人工挑选。
本次检索未凑齐过去48小时内且满足领域覆盖的九条原始来源，采用9月8日至11日发布的报道。9月11日来源也不能仅凭日期保证处于生成时刻前48小时内；所有published均保留页面实际发布日期。
展览、记者会与AI工具均为已经正式公布的未来安排，未写成已经举办、返航或发布。欧洲央行通胀与增长数字为预测，不是实际结果。

上周申请者题未明确可观察信息，参考解答采用仅知道相对排名的经典模型；若可观察绝对能力且已知其分布，最优策略可能不同。高铁解答中的趟数和平均距离均为示例假设。
